scope: Manual Chrome, real Auth0, thin Worker / VPC / native Node Web / FastAPI; explicitly synthetic source
cpuNote: Thin proxy tail reports integer-millisecond CPU samples; zero is reported precision, not proof of zero work. WallTime here does not represent the complete browser stream duration.

thirdTab.note: First tab stopped before successful retry; API was not restarted and limits were not changed

resourceSample.command: docker stats --no-stream --format '{{.Name}} CPU={{.CPUPerc}} MEM={{.MemUsage}}' whisky-discovery-web-1 whisky-discovery-api-1 whisky-discovery-db-1 whisky-discovery-tunnel-1

tokenExpiry.method: Temporarily set project Auth0 API token lifetime to 90 seconds; fresh browser memory session pins its real token across observe reconnects; restored API lifetime to 900 seconds afterward

crossAccount.method: Two distinct real Google sign-ins, explicit Google account chooser for second identity; no JWT fixture

unreadConsumerResourceSample.dbQuery: SELECT state, count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = current_database() GROUP BY state

unreadConsumer.scope: Real browser holds two response bodies unread; after 65 seconds a replacement succeeds without cancelling the held bodies first. Cleanup then aborts all responses. This exercises bounded current compact snapshots, not high-volume socket saturation; stalled ASGI send is separately tested locally.

entryRollback.method: wrangler rollback exact-version --yes; actual HTTP checks after each switch; no database rollback

limitations: Small manual sample, not capacity acceptance
